title: The Secrets Of Cornwall - Part 1 - Communications
summary: A documentary on how Cornwall became a hub for the world's communications, from the first transatlantic radio signal to modern undersea fibre cables. It describes how cable landing stations and the systems are put together.
why: Recommended as a rare look at the unmarked buildings and infrastructure where undersea cables come ashore.

quote.text: Documentary about the cable landing stations: The Secrets of Cornwall
